findings.summary: ghSource reads a run with `gh run view <id> --json jobs`. The nightly has more than 100 jobs, so gh fetches a second page through a numeric-ID URL (repositories/<id>/...), and the agents' HTTPS proxy refuses that with 403. So check-png-evidence --record (M19.52) and ci-evidence's nightly read cannot read any nightly from this environment, and runSource uses REST only when gh is absent. Both legs fail closed, so the gate stays honest. But once a green nightly exists, M19 cannot record it here, and two of its final legs stay red.
findings.evidence: gh run view 43699537326 --json ...,jobs -> 'HTTP 403: Numeric-ID repository paths (repositories/{id}/...) are not supported through this proxy ... jobs?per_page=100&page=2'; packet gate output ci-evidence leg shows the same 403 for 43578498688; scripts/gates/ci-runs.mjs:137,161,204-205 (runSource picks gh whenever installed; restSource uses repos/{owner}/{repo} paths)

findings.summary: M19.38 added two helpers that both pull the definition ids out of a shape's icon slots: apps/studio pack-catalog.ts slotDefIds (inside usedDefIds) and packages/format shape-pack-slots.ts fillDefId/slotIds. They differ: format leaves out builtin and CORE_SHAPE_IDS and studio does not. So what the studio loads and what the save embeds are decided by two rules that can drift apart.

M19.53's rule matches only the phrases 'carried (on) to M<n>.<k>' and 'becomes a (new) backlog row' / 'carried to a new row'. A body saying a minor 'goes to', 'moves to' or 'is deferred to' a row passes it without changing that row. The acceptance listed exactly these wordings, and git.md rule 12 now names the phrase, so this is a convention plus a check, not a full guard.

New row M19.55 (HARNESS, blocks M19.31): when `gh run view` fails, or always for jobs, the run reader in scripts/gates/ci-runs.mjs (ghSource view/jobs) reads a run's jobs through `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/<id>/jobs?per_page=100` with explicit pages, or falls back to restSource. So check-png-evidence --record and check-ci-evidence's nightly read work behind a proxy that refuses numeric-ID repository paths. tests/harness gets a case with a fake gh whose `run view` fails with that 403 while `gh api repos/...` answers, and expects the record written.

Both helpers are right today. Studio's extra ids (builtin and core:*) are already registered, so `ensure` does nothing for them, and the save path is the one that filters. Export format's slotIds (or a schema-level slotDefIds) and have studio usedDefIds call it on the next edit of either file.

The rule catches the two wordings that broke cp5's and cp6's Learned line, and git.md rule 12 now tells authors which phrase to use, so a commit carrying a minor uses it. No phrase list can match free prose. Per-commit review (R11) still reads the body, and the checkpoint review checks each carried minor against the backlog, as cp7 did here.
